extDescription.message: Save the PDF preview already loaded on a StudyDrive document page.

actionTitle.message: StudyDrive PDF Downloader: show the download controls

actionTitleReady.message: StudyDrive PDF Downloader: loaded PDF preview ready

actionTitleError.message: StudyDrive PDF Downloader: the PDF needs attention

hideTitle.message: Hide (show again with the toolbar icon)

statusWaiting.message: Waiting for the document preview to load.

statusWaitingLong.message: No preview detected yet. If the document is already visible, reload the page so the extension can see it load.

statusLoading.message: Capturing the preview as it loads…

statusSuccess.message: Check your browser downloads to see when it finishes.

errorRequestFailed.message: The preview did not finish loading. Reload the page to try again.

errorHttp.message: StudyDrive did not deliver the preview. Reload the page to try again.

errorPartial.message: The viewer loaded only part of this PDF. Partial previews cannot be saved.

errorTooLarge.message: This PDF is larger than the 40 MiB limit.

errorIncomplete.message: The loaded preview was not a complete PDF. Reload the page to try again.

errorUnsupported.message: This preview format is not supported.

errorReadFailed.message: The preview could not be read. Reload the page to try again.

errorBusy.message: A download is already being prepared.

errorNotReady.message: The preview is not ready yet.

errorTimeout.message: Preparing the PDF timed out. Try again.

errorInvalidData.message: The prepared data was not a valid PDF. Reload the page to try again.

errorNoConfirmation.message: No download confirmation. Check your browser downloads before trying again.

errorExtensionUnavailable.message: The extension was updated or reloaded. Reload the page to continue.

errorRejected.message: The download request was rejected for safety reasons. Reload the page to try again.

errorDownloadFailed.message: The browser could not start the download.

onboardingIntro.message: Save the PDF preview that StudyDrive has already loaded in your browser.

onboardingStepOpen.message: Open a document on studydrive.net and let its preview load.

onboardingStepDownload.message: Click “Download PDF” in the corner, or press $SHORTCUT$.

onboardingStepHide.message: Hidden the controls? Click the toolbar icon to show them again.

onboardingReload.message: Reload those tabs once. The extension can only see previews that load after it is installed.

onboardingLimitTitle.message: Preview, not necessarily the full document

onboardingLimit.message: The saved file is the preview your browser loaded. It may have fewer pages than the original. Maximum size: 40 MiB.

onboardingPrivacy.message: Everything stays in your browser: no extra document requests, no analytics, no external servers. Only use documents you are allowed to download.
